scope: one explicitly selected local OS user
title: Enable native game capture
explanation: Install a separate system helper with administrator permission. It observes server-to-client TCP traffic on ports 3101 and 5222 for connections owned by your OS account, including other apps using those ports. The helper sends bounded records to the local ROK Battles agent, which uploads server bytes for protocol classification; only recognized game mail is stored. Client payloads are excluded. Zero-payload client control headers stay on this device. The helper does not decode, save, or upload packets. Capture still needs separate opt-in, and mailcache remains available without it.

states.notInstalled: Native capture needs one-time system helper setup
states.permissionDenied: System permission was not granted. Mailcache remains available
states.backendMissing: Install the supported system libpcap package, then retry setup
states.ownershipUnavailable: This OS or sandbox cannot safely attribute the game connection. Native capture is unavailable
states.ready: Helper is installed. Native capture starts only when you enable it
states.connectionEnded: Native capture stopped. Reconnect the game after restarting capture

unsupported: automatic elevation or installation on application launch
running the GUI or desktop agent as root
granting the GUI packet capabilities or changing all BPF device permissions
Flatpak directly loading a privileged capture backend
other network namespaces or hidden process ownership
user-selected library paths, filters, interfaces or commands
